# Helicone Documentation

> > Open-source LLM observability platform for monitoring, optimizing, and debugging AI applications across OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Nvidia NIM, and other providers.

Helicone provides comprehensive observability tools for LLM applications including request logging, cost tracking, prompt management, caching, and performance analytics. The platform supports both proxy-based and async integration methods with Apache 2.0 open-source licensing.

## Key Topics

- LLM Observability
- AI Gateway
- OpenAI SDK Integration
- Cost Tracking
- Prompt Caching
- Custom Properties
- Async Logging
- REST API
- Anthropic
- AWS Bedrock
- Nvidia NIM
- Request Analytics
- Dataset Management
- Webhook Integration
- Open Source (Apache 2.0)

## Integration Methods & Core Concepts

- [Proxy vs Async Integration](https://docs.helicone.ai/references/proxy-vs-async): Compare Helicone Proxy and Async integration methods for LLM apps
- [Open Source](https://docs.helicone.ai/references/open-source): Helicone's Apache 2.0 license, GitHub repos, and contribution guidelines
- [Prompt Caching](https://docs.helicone.ai/gateway/concepts/prompt-caching): Cache frequent context across LLM providers for cost reduction and speed
- [Custom Properties](https://docs.helicone.ai/features/advanced-usage/custom-properties): Add custom metadata to LLM requests for filtering and cost tracking

## Features & Tools

- [Reports](https://docs.helicone.ai/features/reports): Automated weekly LLM usage, cost, and performance summaries via email/Slack
- [Datasets](https://docs.helicone.ai/features/datasets): Curate and export LLM request/response data for fine-tuning and analysis
- [Prompt Engineering Overview](https://docs.helicone.ai/guides/prompt-engineering/overview): Strategic prompt crafting techniques for LLM optimization and accuracy
- [Helicone Evals with Ragas](https://docs.helicone.ai/guides/cookbooks/helicone-evals-with-ragas): Evaluate LLM applications using Ragas integration with Helicone

## Provider Integrations

- [AWS Bedrock JavaScript SDK](https://docs.helicone.ai/integrations/bedrock/javascript): Integrate AWS Bedrock with Helicone using JavaScript SDK
- [Nvidia NIM JavaScript SDK](https://docs.helicone.ai/integrations/nvidia/javascript): Integrate Nvidia NIM with Helicone using OpenAI JavaScript SDK
- [Nvidia NIM cURL Integration](https://docs.helicone.ai/integrations/nvidia/curl): Use cURL to log Nvidia NIM LLM usage through Helicone AI Gateway
- [Llama Python SDK](https://docs.helicone.ai/integrations/llama/python): Log Llama usage via Helicone using OpenAI Python SDK integration
- [Anyscale Integration](https://docs.helicone.ai/getting-started/integration-method/anyscale): Connect Anyscale-deployed LLMs (Llama, Mistral, GPT) with Helicone
- [Dify](https://docs.helicone.ai/other-integrations/dify): Add observability to Dify open-source LLM app platform via Helicone

## REST API Reference

- [Get Requests](https://docs.helicone.ai/rest/request/post-v1requestquery-clickhouse): ClickHouse endpoint to query all requests in Helicone request table
- [Get Prompt Versions](https://docs.helicone.ai/rest/prompts/post-v1prompt-2025-query-versions): REST API endpoint to retrieve all versions of a specific prompt
- [Get Models](https://docs.helicone.ai/rest/ai-gateway/get-v1models): OpenAI-compatible endpoint returning all Helicone AI Gateway models
- [Get Multimodal Models](https://docs.helicone.ai/rest/ai-gateway/get-v1models-multimodal): API endpoint returning all multimodal models in Helicone AI Gateway
- [Get User Data](https://docs.helicone.ai/rest/user/post-v1userquery): REST API to retrieve user data by ID and time filters
- [Get Webhooks](https://docs.helicone.ai/rest/webhooks/get-v1webhooks): REST API endpoint to retrieve all configured webhooks
